notes: Smith School of Business and Economics departmental hosts disallow our fetcher via robots.txt, so those programmes are not collected. English minimums for programmes whose page defers to the School of Graduate Studies are cited from its apply page (source_sha256). SGSPA states TOEFL only on the 1-6 scale, so it is given as text. The phs.queensu.ca pages returned no text even when rendered. Deadlines stated without a year were left out. Coordinator: the five thesis-based Master of Applied Science programmes were removed (research degrees, as for Waterloo, UBC and McMaster).
